OUT_PIN_DOC: BCM GPIO number connected to the OUT lead of the Mausberry board (default 23).
IN_PIN_DOC: BCM GPIO number connected to the IN lead of the Mausberry board (default 24).
DELAY_DOC: Seconds to wait after the switch is turned off before shutting down. The shutdown cannot be cancelled during this time.
SAVED: Settings saved, the switch service was restarted
ERR_PIN: GPIO pins must be whole numbers from 2 to 27
ERR_SAME_PIN: OUT and IN must be different pins
ERR_DELAY: The delay must be a whole number from 0 to 3600
ERR_WRITE: Could not save the settings, see the Volumio log
ERR_NOT_INSTALLED: The mausberry-switch service is not installed. Reinstall the plugin.
